psychological_meaning: Saddle is a grounded and comforting color, evoking feelings of stability, reliability, and connection to the earth. It suggests warmth, resilience, and a sense of history, reminding us of natural materials and time-worn objects. It can also represent a sense of tradition and craftsmanship.
